Homer plans to keep the Cannonball from making its Christmas caroling tour.

title: Annie Oakley

Annie (Gail Davis) becomes involved in a controversy between a teen (Carolyn Craig) and her overly possessive father (Ewing Mitchell).

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) try to discover the identity of a masked man known as the Robin Hood Kid (Tyler MacDuff).

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) step in when a young cavalry officer (Harry Lauter) is framed for murder.

description:

Lofty (Brad Johnson) faces a moral dilemma when confronted with a notorious outlaw who once saved his life. With Lane Bradford, Bill Henry.

description:

A notorious outlaw arrives during an election to shed a bad light on his brother, an honest lawyer running for office.

title: Annie Oakley
description:

The son (Stuffy Singer) of a slain deputy has suspicions about his caregiver (Leonard Penn), a reformed outlaw.

description:

Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) attend a friend's wedding and investigate the best man's murder.

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) uncovers a scheme involving honest ranchers, a band of greedy crooks and a valuable oil pool. With Monte Blue, Jim Bannon.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

description:

description:

Jeff Taggert's brother is accused of robbing the Del Rio bank; while investigating the case, Jeff becomes implicated in the hold-up.

description:

description:

A young man is accused of murder; he makes a run for it.

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

Tiburcio Vasquez vows vengeance against Anglos after his sister Dolores is killed; Matt and Frankie try to stop his years of terror in Southern California after a railroad agent is killed with the help of a local priest.

title: Bonanza
description:

For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

description:

title: Bonanza
description:

Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

title: Bonanza
description:

Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

description:

After being wrongfully jailed on a murder charge, Cisco and Pancho escape to capture the real murderer.

description:

Cisco is challenged by a man who seeks revenge after being jailed.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E08 — Medicine Flats
Cisco and Pancho hope to imprison the leader of a rustling ring.

description:

A con man resorts to murder in a phony land promotion scheme.

description:

The man behind a string of stagecoach robberies has remained out of reach of company detectives Matt and Frankie, but reinforcements from the city help to crack the case.

description:

Elected as mayor, an outlaw deputizes members of his gang.

description:

A killer escapes from prison and tries to reunite with his girlfriend.

description:

Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

description:

More unrest between the white men and the Ottawas.

description:

Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle; they ask Hawkeye to lead them but when he discovers that it is in a sacred Dakota burial ground he tries to dissuade them.

description:

Lt. Briggs breaks the treaty by chasing an Indian beyond the recognized border; led into an ambush he escapes but his militiamen are captured; Hawkeye and Chingachgook are assigned to escort him to his court-martial and probable hanging.

description:

A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent Mingo False Faces.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:

Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away and told that the town is closed due to an outbreak of the black plague; Hawkeye decides to sneak in and see for himself.

description:

A young lieutenant seeks blind vengeance for the brutal murders of his parents by warmongering Shawnee.

description:

Hawkeye and Chingachgook match their wits against two thieves who have phony identities.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.
